protocol:
1. Attach a clear disposable pipette tip from the pink tip rack to a single-channel adjustable micropipette.

2. Hold an open labeled microcentrifuge tube from the white tube rack and insert the pipette tip into the tube.

3. Pipette clear liquid in the open microcentrifuge tube using the single-channel micropipette, then withdraw the tip.

4. Place the handled microcentrifuge tube back into the white tube rack with its cap open.

5. Select another open labeled microcentrifuge tube from the white rack and hold it by the hinged cap.

6. Insert the pipette tip into the second microcentrifuge tube and pipette clear liquid in the tube.

7. Return the second microcentrifuge tube to the white rack and position the next open labeled tube.

8. Pipette clear liquid in another open microcentrifuge tube seated in the white rack.

9. Move the pipette tip to the translucent beaker on the bench and empty the tip into the beaker.

10. Reposition the white tube rack containing several open labeled microcentrifuge tubes on the bench.

11. Use the single-channel micropipette to pipette clear liquid into another open microcentrifuge tube in the rack.

12. Pipette clear liquid in a neighboring open microcentrifuge tube in the same white rack.

13. Move the pipette tip to the translucent beaker again and empty the remaining liquid from the tip.

14. Open a Petri dish containing pink culture medium and place the dish on the bench beside the prepared microcentrifuge tubes.
